**Eric So Kar-Fai** is a [Mattel](/wiki/Mattel) employee based in Hong Kong who has been working at Mattel since [1994](/wiki/1994); he mainly designs playsets. Prior to his stint at Mattel, he worked for a number of small Hong Kong-based toy design companies for a number of years before making the switch. He worked at El Segundo for about a year in 2004. Within Hong Kong, he is nicknamed the "human printer".
